text:
maya: Quick async standup — canary update.
What I did: bumped slice-7 from 5% -> 8%, ran KV warmup script against the warm nodes, and executed the smoke harness.
Blockers: seeing intermittent 502s from inference-gateway during drain/rebalance, appears transient but reproduced twice. digging into traces.
Today: finish ramp to 10% if stable, address PR #3621 for the feature-flag gating logic, and coordinate rollback plan with @sam.

jon: Saw the 502s in the same window. My hunch is the shard rebalancer is bumping older nodes before healthchecks finish.
I pushed a temporary healthcheck backoff tweak to staging. Can you paste the error snippet you saw?

maya: here's the log excerpt I captured:
```
ERROR inference-gateway: upstream returned 502 for /v1/generate uid=trace-0a7b3f ts=2026-03-15T09:12:08Z shard=slice-7 node=i-03a... msg="upstream-reset"
WARN proxy: retrying request after connection reset
```
(reproduced at ~09:12 and ~09:18 UTC)

oliver: If it's timing related, we should increase the kv_warmup timeout to 30s and add a small backoff to the rebalancer kill-switch.
I have a small PR ready for the safety fallback toggles: https://git.example.com/redwood/infra/pull/145 — can someone review?

deploy-bot: smoke tests for slice-7: 6/6 checks green :white_check_mark: (run-id: smoke-20260315-0915)

sam: I'm standing by for rollback. If we need to cut, flip the feature-flag `ff/rollout/dawn/slice-7` -> `off` and run `rb-apply --slice=7`.
I can execute within 5m if @maya gives the go.

elaine: quick note — left comments on #3621 about the gating policy (edge case when cache-miss spikes). small naming nit as well. Also flagged infra about a CPU spike on the g4dn-8x instances in slice-7.

jon: I'll hold the ramp until the 502 root cause is clearer. @maya please post final before moving to 10%.

maya: Ack. digging through traces and will run a rebalancer dry-run now. If no more 502s in the next 10m I'll proceed to 10% and ping here. ETA ~12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: canary ramp to 10% complete; metrics stable; no new 502s in last 15m :rocket: (rollout-id: rlt-20260315-10pct)
